name: SPGISpeech
description: An approximately 5,000-hour corpus of English financial-domain audio with human transcripts, assembled from earnings calls and intended for automatic speech recognition research.
citation: O'Neill, P., Mavlyutov, R., Bulyko, I., & Ostendorf, M. (2021). SPGISpeech: 5,000 hours of transcribed financial audio for speech recognition. Interspeech 2021.
